text:
Miguel (eng-platform): Quick heads-up — preflight for the staged rollout tonight at 23:00 UTC. This is a region-staggered release (eu -> na -> apac). Plan: 10% canary for 30m, then ramp by 30m windows. Posting proposed statuspage copy below, need support + SRE sign-off.

Aisha (eng): Thanks. Which service pins are we using for the canary? Will we pin to v2.3.1-rc or the full v2.3.1?

Miguel (eng-platform): Canary will use v2.3.1-rc on hosted and dedicated; private deployments are untouched. If canary looks good, we'll roll to pinned v2.3.1 for remaining hosts.

Nina (sre): Checking rollback criteria: 5xx rate > 0.5% OR latency p95 > 800ms sustained for 10 minutes should trigger an automatic hold + rollback. Also require at least one succeeded smoke check in the second canary window before ramp.

Aisha (eng): Noted. We should also enable the model-variant fallback (quantized-compat) on the canary hosts in case of GPU OOMs — lower perf but avoids app failures.

deploy-bot: deploy plan created: rollout/1799998888. Steps: create canary group -> deploy v2.3.1-rc -> run smoke (smoke.sh) -> wait 30m -> autoscale check -> ramp. Canary healthchecks: /health, token-perf, kv-cache-hit-rate.

Sam (support): Drafting customer-facing statuspage and email copy. Posting initial snippet for review: 

```
Scheduled maintenance: Staged rollout of runtime update (v2.3.1) — targeted at hosted API and Dedicated clusters.
Start: Today 23:00 UTC
Impact: Brief request routing retries possible for a small subset of customers during canary windows. No expected data loss.
If we detect regressions we will pause and roll back. Updates will be posted here.
```

Leo (product): Can we add a short changelog blurb? Customers like to know what's in the release. Maybe: "Performance improvements for KV cache and reduced token latency on long prompts."

Sam (support): Adding changelog sentence. Also planning to include a dedicated 'customers potentially affected' segment: Hosted API customers in EU region and Dedicated pools with GPU A and B. Any objections?

Miguel (eng-platform): That's accurate. For Dedicated, we'll send targeted emails to tenants with pinned capacity. Public statuspage should be general; tenant emails can include more specifics.

Nina (sre): One more ops note — oncall should be @oncall-sre for eu window, then rotate to @oncall-sre-na. Also set alerting threshold: 3 incidents in 2 minutes -> incident channel spike.

Aisha (eng): For rollout safety, I'm going to enable conservative batching (batch_limit=8) for canary only, to reduce load spikes. Will push config at +10m into canary window.

Sam (support): Updated statuspage copy with changelog and short FAQ. Final public snippet below — please review quickly, I need to publish ~15m before start. 

```
Public status update (to be posted at 22:45 UTC):
Title: Staged runtime update (v2.3.1) — rolling maintenance
Body: We will perform a staged rollout of a runtime update that includes performance improvements to KV cache and reduced token latency for long prompts. The rollout will start at 23:00 UTC and will be applied region-by-region. During the canary windows a very small percentage of requests may see retries or transient elevated latency while we validate health. We will pause and roll back automatically if we detect issues.
Affected: Hosted API (EU first), Dedicated GPU pools (A,B). Private deployments not affected.
Updates: We will post progress here and send email notifications to tenants where applicable.
```

Miguel (eng-platform): OK from platform side. Two asks: include the support contact link (support@redwood.ai) in the status body, and add the rollback clause from Nina verbatim.

Sam (support): Added support link and rollback clause. New snippet ready. I'm going to schedule the post at 22:45 UTC.

Nina (sre): Signed off on monitoring/readiness. I'm on standby at 22:30 UTC. If canary fails we'll call an immediate rollback and pin previous model.

Aisha (eng): Config changes ready, will push at T+10m into canary window as planned.

Leo (product): Approved. Please include a short "release notes" link in the customer email pointing to /releases/2.3.1.

Miguel (eng-platform): All set. @deploy-bot kick at 23:00 UTC unless we have any last-minute objections. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: acknowledged — scheduled run at 23:00 UTC. Will post status updates to #eng-platform and #support automatically.

Sam (support): Publishing public status update now. Will queue tenant emails for Dedicated clusters in EU and NA.

Miguel (eng-platform): Thanks everyone. If we need an emergency rollback, I'll call it and ping #incidents and affected tenant leads.

Nina (sre): Copy. Oncall rotation noted. See you at 22:30 for the final smoke-run. :eyes:
